Package fr.sorbonne_u.components.tasks_management

Thread management for BCM4Java.

See: Description

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BCM4JavaComponentThread
    The class BCM4JavaComponentThread defines a specific type of threads for rBCM4Java which names derives from the URI of their owner component and which possess an Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler printing a message on System.err.
    BCM4JavaComponentThreadFactory
    The class BCM4JavaComponentThreadFactory proposes a standard thread factory for BCM4Java creating threads that are instances of BCM4JavaComponentThread.
    BCM4JavaScheduledThreadPoolExecutor
    The class BCM4JavaScheduledThreadPoolExecutor implements specific scheduled thread pool executors for BCM4Java that allows asynchronous callers to be notified when a call ends up abnormally (raising a throwable).
    BCM4JavaThreadPoolExecutor
    The class BCM4JavaThreadPoolExecutor implements specific thread pool executors for BCM4Java that allows asynchronous callers to be notified when a call ends up abnormally (raising a throwable).
